feature_contract.goal: Avoid unnecessary synchronous D3D9 render-state driver readback on normal depth-disabled and single-sided-stencil world/HUD stereo rendering while preserving exact right-eye depth and stencil write safety.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R33 final stereo draw owner depth/stencil lazy snapshot and its negative regression verifier only; do not alter drawing, GPU sync, protected SkyGlow, optics, FFB, or other backend branches.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Static hot-path inspection showed R33 cold-cache refresh always requests ZWRITEENABLE despite disabled Z and three CCW stencil ops despite single-sided mode; optimization removes these unnecessary getter calls during material/stateblock invalidation rebuilds. Actual FPS remains unmeasured.
trace_stages: Original game SetRenderState and StateBlock::Apply drive the authoritative D3D9 state with tracked setter/generation fences.
R33ReadDepthStencilWriteState rebuilds the per-draw depth/stencil write shadow only when cache invalidated or ownership changed.
R33GetWriteFlags and R33TryFastWorld/R33TryHud gate right-eye depth/stencil sync, preserving original and per-eye Draw/DrawIndexed behavior.
subcomponents: Skip ZWRITEENABLE read under disabled Z, invalidate and resample on ZENABLE activation including reset/Apply generations.
Skip three CCW operation reads under one-sided stencil, invalidate and resample on two-sided enable; retain stencil enable/mask/format and failure fences.
Extend R33 source contract with destructive mutation tests for both lazy predicates, both invalidation transitions and depth/stencil fail-closed reads.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Disabled depth testing skips the ZWRITEENABLE driver read until a tracked depth-enable transition, with no world/HUD stereo write-flag changes.
One-sided stencil skips CCW reads, two-sided reenable invalidates stale snapshot, getter failures and StateBlock reset remain fail closed.
Negative-mutation source policy, exact-SHA Windows game and OpenXR host builds, package, Domain Isolation and source impact all pass before build acceptance.

diagnosis.original_evidence: GitHub HEAD fa0233e35a3f923a3042ae15950b7e60a608b3a9 R33ReadDepthStencilWriteState explicitly called ZWRITEENABLE whenever a depth target was attached and three CCW stencil ops whenever stencil was enabled with a nonzero mask, even if two-sided mode was false. No hardware FPS measurement exists.
source_trace: Original game SetRenderState and StateBlock Apply publish ZENABLE, ZWRITEENABLE and TWOSIDEDSTENCILMODE into the D3D9 tracked state/epoch.
R33ReadDepthStencilWriteState, invalidated by attachment/Apply/reset generations and state setters, captures live depth/stencil draw-write safety before routing R33TryFastWorld/R33TryHud.
R33GetWriteFlags protects right-eye depth/stencil content synchronization and R33 final dispatcher duplicates the original Draw per eye without changing shaders, WVP, world or HUD rendering.
diagnosis.root_cause: R33 cold-snapshot rebuild unconditionally read ZWRITEENABLE even when depth was disabled, and three CCW stencil operations even in one-sided mode, causing four avoidable synchronous D3D9 driver getters during high churn in world/HUD particle scenes.
alternatives_rejected: Unconditionally caching ZWRITEENABLE or CCW fields without state transition invalidation would miss later disabled-to-enabled Z or one-to-two-sided stencil transitions and could incorrectly reuse stale depth/stencil write flags.
Skipping any reads while two-sided stencil or depth testing is active would weaken fail-closed eye-depth content tracking.
Skipping StateBlock/Reset generation checks or changing actual Draw routes would risk stereo world/overlay correctness and would not solve the cold driver readback bottleneck.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R33 C++ material SHA ac8b837f3f0d121b97f47fe5b5689adbd576c33c: gate ZWRITEENABLE under nonzero ZENABLE and CCW getters under two-sided stencil, invalidate partial snapshot on reenable; exact-SHA DX9Ex Active 5/5, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact 3/3 and HUD Inspector 2/2 all SUCCESS.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: tools/verify_vr_r33_stencil_snapshot_fastpath.py adds disabled-depth and one-sided gating negative mutations, both re-enable invalidation mutations, source readback ordering, failure-close checks and existing protected stencil tests, executed in passed exact-SHA Active policy job.

runtime_gate: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED; Quest3/VDXR gameplay/visual pass and actual CPU/FPS improvement are not claimed.
